incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] 1802504321 - Multiple pod evictions in redwood-serving across nodes with local-ssd. Event spike: PodEvicted + kubelet reports ephemeral-storage pressure. Affected namespace: redwood-serving. Severity: P1. Paging oncall SRE.

Alice Chen: I'm oncall, looking. Any immediate customer-facing symptoms? :eyes:

Support Pager: seeing ~1200 5xxs in the last 5m from hosted API region-us-east-1, mostly generate requests to model-id=rwd-large-v2. Customers reporting timeouts and partial responses.

Alice Chen: copying logs from one of the restarted pods (pod runtime-76f9). The kubelet shows eviction due to ephemeral-storage pressure:
```
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age    From     Message
  ----    ------     ----   ----     -------
  Warning Evicted    2m23s  kubelet  The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
```
And runtime log shows repeated OOM/CUDA issues after restart:
```
[ERROR] runtime: CUDA error: out of memory (cuMemAlloc) at 0x7f3a
[ERROR] runtime: failed to allocate kv cache
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
```

Marco Rivera: likely two problems compounding: model cache growth on local-ssd + heavy logging (rlogs) filling ephemeral disk. When eviction triggers, pods restart mid-loading and the runtime loses model artifacts -> CUDA init failures and OOMs on rewarm.

Priya Nair: checked node metrics -> ephemeral-storage usage on nodes gpu-ssd-5/6/7 at 92-98%. Also noticed kubelet eviction threshold kicked in. `du -sh /var/lib/redwood/cache` on gpu-ssd-6 shows ~220G used, model cache limit configured at 200G but older caches weren't pruned.

Alice Chen: immediate mitigation plan:
  1) Reduce traffic to heavy model: update routing to fallback smaller model (rwd-medium) and enable 50% traffic split to fallback. Marco, can you flip the traffic? (will reduce memory pressure)
  2) Cordon + drain one most-pressured node (gpu-ssd-6) and manually clean cache entries for inactive models: `rm -rf /var/lib/redwood/cache/<old-model-id>` then uncordon.
  3) Increase ephemeral-storage eviction threshold temporarily on affected nodes (kubelet config) to avoid cascading evictions while we clear space.
  4) Scale up nodepool by 2 gpu nodes and enable autoscaling override for 30 minutes.

Marco Rivera: ACK. On it. Will switch traffic to rwd-medium and scale nodepool. Pushing canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: route update to rwd-medium (canary 20%) by Marco Rivera at 1802504445.

Marco Rivera: Canary traffic green. Increasing to 50% now. :thumbsup:

Alice Chen: cordoning gpu-ssd-6, draining pods (will prefer evicting pods gracefully). Running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-ssd-6
kubectl drain gpu-ssd-6 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

Priya Nair: while draining, I SSHed into gpu-ssd-6 and ran:
```
df -h /var/lib/redwood
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/nvme1n1p1  300G  280G   20G  94% /var/lib/redwood
```
I cleaned logs under `/var/log/redwood/requests` older than 3 days and pruned stale cache shards. Freed ~35G.

Alice Chen: after cleaning, uncordoning and letting runtime reschedule. Observability shows pod restarts dropped by ~70% in the last 3m. 5xx count trending down.

Support Pager: 5xx rate down to ~300 in last 5m, still elevated but customer-facing errors diminishing. Notifying customers on status page now (drafted message).

Marco Rivera: still seeing some CUDA init failures on pods that restarted while cache was incomplete. Temporary workaround: set env var `RW_RUNTIME_CACHE_SIZE=4G` and restart runtime to avoid trying to mmap huge cache during startup. Will roll a small restart on 2 pods at a time.

Alice Chen: good. Also let's enable runtime fallback to CPU-backed smaller model for requests that hit a crashed pod (configure router fallback). Priya, can you patch the service config?

Priya Nair: patching router to fallback to cpu-rwd-small for 5% of requests when GPU pod healthcheck fails. Patch applied at 1802504890.

incident-bot: NOTE: Oncall handoff scheduled in 1 hour. Current incident state: mitigating actions applied (traffic split, node cordon + clean, cache pruning, nodepool scale). Severity P1 -> customer impact reduced but not fully mitigated. Page next oncall for follow-up.

Alice Chen: Summary for handoff -> severity P1, root cause: local-ssd model cache + aggressive log retention exhausted ephemeral-storage causing kubelet + pod evictions -> subsequent pod restarts produce incomplete model loads and CUDA OOMs. Mitigations applied: traffic switched to smaller model (50%), cordoned/drained gpu-ssd-6 and cleaned cache (~35G freed), increased nodepool by 2 nodes, set runtime cache size env var to reduce startup working set, router fallback to CPU small model for unhealthy pods. Current impact: API 5xx rate reduced from 1200->300, latency elevated for some requests, some customers still seeing errors.

Ian Park: I'm taking over for the next shift. Plan for follow-up:
  - Ensure persistent fix: implement automated cache pruning and enforce cache size per-node with eviction policy.
  - Add kubelet eviction early warning alert for ephemeral-storage > 85% per node.
  - Review log retention/rotation for redwood runtime logs to avoid unexpected growth.
  - Postmortem owner: Marco Rivera + Priya Nair. Aim to have a draft within 48h.

Alice Chen: thanks Ian. I'll post the action items to the incident channel and update the status page: 'degraded -> partially degraded'. Also running through customer list to notify top affected customers.

Marco Rivera: quick note: need to add a runtime flag to write caches to mounted PV instead of node-local SSD for models >100G, will prototype this week.

deploy-bot: route update completed by Marco Rivera at 1802504530. Canary -> 50%.

incident-bot: Paging next oncall: @Ian Park. Handoff recorded. Incident is in mitigation. If anyone sees re-escalation, re-paging will occur.

Ian Park: I confirm takeover. Will monitor for 1 hour, then start postmortem doc.

Alice Chen: :thumbsup: closing my active involvement, will stay available for questions.

Support Pager: status page updated at 1802504960: 'Partial service degradation in us-east-1 due to storage pressure on GPU nodes. Mitigations in progress.'

Marco Rivera: logging a short runbook step: when node eviction due to ephemeral-storage occurs -> cordon+drain -> prune model cache -> restart pods in rolling fashion -> if still recurs, scale nodepool and enable fallback routing. Will add to infra-runbooks.

incident-bot: Incident timeline recorded. End of thread for now.
